storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playergotohospital

storyArray.name: nurse
dialogue: 這裡是醫院嗎？

storyArray.name: nurse
dialogue: 公主，是王都的情報組把你送來醫院的。
你所受的只是皮外傷，幾天後就會康復。
可是，羅西亞就慘了...瑪利亞剛剛過身了...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 不會吧？我馬上去看看羅西亞！

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playergotorosia

storyArray.name: rosia
dialogue: 妹妹...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 瑪利亞現在很安詳...我們讓她安息吧...

storyArray.name: rosia
dialogue: 嗯...我想靜一下...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 羅西亞...

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: rosialeave

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 公主...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 瑪利亞？你不是已經病逝嗎？

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 對，我已經死了。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 那麼...這是...

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 大概是因為公主有到東盟國修行，我的靈魂才可以跟公主同步。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 世間最苦，不過別離...真不敢想像你姐姐現在有多難受...

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 姐姐表面看似堅強，但長期為了我的事情而奔波的她...
內心早已經接近崩毀邊緣。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 真令人擔心，我馬上去看看你姐姐吧。

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 距離轉生前還有一段時間...
如公主不嫌棄，請讓我陪同公主去找姐姐吧。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 好的。

storyArray.name: narrator
dialogue: 瑪利亞加入隊伍，在戰鬥中瑪利亞能夠每秒治愈公主5點血量。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playergoforrosia

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 姐姐！

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 瑪利亞，我們該如何是好？

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 公主只要用最真誠的心去為姐姐祈福就行。

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 我試試吧。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: rosiadelusion

storyArray.name: rosia
dialogue: 我的一生...真是充滿...苦難...

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 姐姐，這一切都是幻境...

storyArray.name: rosia
dialogue: 你是誰？別假扮我的妹妹！我的妹妹已經死了！

storyArray.name: maria
dialogue: 沒有生死，靈魂不滅...
別被假象所蒙騙，破迷啟悟，尋找清淨之藏...

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: rosiathink

storyArray.name: rosia
dialogue: 尋找清淨之藏？
